subject: Enterprise identity kickoff: SSO, SCIM, IP allowlists & service accounts
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Adams <rachel.adams@finexa.com>, Finexa IT <it@finexa.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Enterprise identity kickoff: SSO, SCIM, IP allowlists & service accounts

Hi Rachel / Finexa IT team —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the identity and onboarding work for your Redwood deployment. Goal for this thread: align on a short implementation plan and list the concrete artifacts we need to start the SSO/SCIM and networking changes. Proposed 3-week cadence: discovery -> config -> validation -> handover.

High-level asks to get us moving:
- SAML metadata (IdP metadata XML) or ACS / Entity ID values
- SCIM provisioning: do you want us to push accounts from your IdP? If so, confirm the SCIM base URL and an initial service account for provisioning
- IP allowlist: list of CIDR ranges that need firewall whitelisting for our hosted endpoints (or we can provide static egress IPs if you prefer)
- Service accounts: which product teams need long-lived service accounts vs short-lived ephemeral keys; any rotation policy we should follow

I attached our onboarding checklist (2025-11-03_redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) and a short guidance PDF on service account best practices (service-accounts-guidance.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
1) You share SAML metadata + SCIM URL by end of this week
2) We'll schedule a 30-min technical runbook session with Monica (implementation lead) and Neha (security engineer)
3) We'll provision a staging tenant and validate SSO + SCIM end-to-end

If that works, Marissa will follow up on dates for the runbook meeting.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

— Jonas Weber
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: 2025-11-03_redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: service-accounts-guidance.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Rachel Adams <rachel.adams@finexa.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finexa IT <it@finexa.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enterprise identity kickoff: SSO, SCIM, IP allowlists & service accounts

Jonas — thanks, this looks good. Quick answers from our side:
- We can export SAML metadata and share it; our IdP is Azure AD / Entra ID. We'll attach the metadata and include the ACS URL and Entity ID.
- For SCIM, we plan to enable provisioning from Entra. Our SCIM base URL will be https://scim.finexa.com/v2 and we'll provide a service account for provisioning (scim-bot@finexa.com).
- IP ranges: currently we allow egress to 52.12.0.0/16 and 18.204.0.0/15 for vendor services. We'll confirm whether we need to expand.
- Service accounts: product teams prefer rotating keys every 90 days; we also require MFA for interactive sessions.

A couple of questions: does Redwood support Entra Group-to-Role mapping for provisioning (we'd like groups in Entra to map to Redwood org roles)? Also, can you confirm whether the SCIM integration requires mutual TLS or just bearer token auth?

I'll attach the SAML metadata (will send in a follow-up email) and loop in our infra contact Carl (cc'd).

— Rachel
Director, Product Security — Finexa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Adams <rachel.adams@finexa.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enterprise identity kickoff: SSO, SCIM, IP allowlists & service accounts

Thanks Rachel — helpful. Short answers:
- Entra group-to-role mapping: yes, we support mapping SCIM groups to Redwood org roles. We'll share a mapping template you can fill out.
- SCIM auth: Redwood supports bearer token-based SCIM with a provisioning token scoped to the org; mutual TLS is optional but supported for customers that require it. Please indicate in your reply if you'd prefer mTLS and we will provision a client cert flow.

Monica will lead the technical runbook and scheduling — Monica, can you propose two 30-min slots this week for a runbook + test sync? Neha, we'll need you on the call for the IP allowlist / egress validation.

Action items I've added to the checklist:
- Finexa: send saml-metadata.xml and service account for SCIM provisioning
- Redwood: prepare SCIM group-to-role mapping template and provisioning token (or mTLS cert if requested)
- Both: agree on staging IP allowlist and a plan for production cutover (we typically ask customers to allowlist staging IPs a week before cutover)

On the rotation policy: Redwood supports key rotation tooling and recommends 90-day rotation for long-lived tokens; we can automate rotation for service accounts used for SCIM provisioning if you want us to manage it.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Runbook slots and quick checklist (Finexa)

Internal note — proposed slots for runbook + test:
- Thu, Nov 6: 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu, Nov 6: 15:00–15:30 PT

Pre-call checklist I'll run through:
1) Confirm saml-metadata.xml fields (IdP SSO URL, Entity ID, x509 cert)
2) Confirm SCIM base URL + provisioning account credentials (we'll ask for a temporary token or cert)
3) Confirm staging IP CIDRs to allowlist (we'll provide staging egress set)
4) Create a temporary service account in Finexa staging org for validation
5) Validate SCIM group->role mapping with a small test (create 3 accounts, assign groups)
6) Edge cases: overlapping group names, duplicate emails, service account collision, and SCIM pagination limits

I'll prepare the mapping template and a short test plan to share on the call. Marissa — can you confirm attendee list from the Finexa side and own calendar coordination?

— Monica
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Carl Nguyen <c.nguyen@finexa.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Adams <rachel.adams@finexa.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enterprise identity kickoff: SSO, SCIM, IP allowlists & service accounts

Folks — attaching our SAML metadata and the provisioning account details.

Attachment: saml-metadata.xml (application/xml) — contains EntityID: https://idp.finexa.com and ACS: https://app.redwood.prod/acs
Attachment: scim-provisioning-creds.txt (text/plain) — contains bearer token for scim-bot@finexa.com (token masked in this thread)

We confirm the IP ranges below should be allowed for staging and prod validation:
- 52.12.128.0/17 (vendor egress pool)
- 18.204.0.0/15 (additional vendor range)

One more question: what's Redwood's recommended TTL for service account tokens used by SCIM? We prefer short lived if rotation is manual; if you can auto-rotate every 7 days that'd be ideal. Also confirm if Redwood will honor group membership removals as immediate deprovisioning in the next sync window.

Thanks — Carl
Finexa Infrastructure
